entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE registration to PLMN or SNPN, including initial registration, periodic registration update, mobility registration update, and SNPN onboarding registration.

entities.name: Requested NSSAI
entities.description: Network slice selection assistance information sent by UE to AMF during registration, indicating intended network slice(s) for registration.

entities.name: Allowed NSSAI
entities.description: Network slice selection assistance information provided by AMF to UE, indicating permitted network slices for the PLMN or SNPN.

entities.name: Configured NSSAI
entities.description: Pre-configured network slice selection assistance information stored in the UE for a specific PLMN or SNPN.

entities.name: Default configured NSSAI
entities.description: Default network slice selection assistance information used when UE has neither allowed nor configured NSSAI for current PLMN/SNPN.

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: Single network slice selection assistance information, the building block of NSSAI representing individual network slices.

entities.name: Mapped S-NSSAI
entities.description: S-NSSAI mapped between visited and home PLMN in roaming scenarios.

entities.name: 5GS registration type
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of registration procedure being performed.

entities.name: Registration type conditions
entities.description: Conditions based on 5GS registration type IE value that determine whether requested NSSAI or allowed NSSAI are included in registration procedure.

entities.name: AMF NSSAI verification
entities.description: AMF verifies if requested NSSAI is permitted based on subscribed S-NSSAIs and optionally mapped S-NSSAI(s) provided by UE.

entities.name: Generic UE configuration update procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to update UE configuration including NSSAI parameters and may trigger registration procedure.

relations.description: Registration procedure includes requested NSSAI IE when UE registers to PLMN/SNPN.
Registration procedure includes allowed NSSAI IE provided by AMF to UE.
Requested NSSAI includes one or more S-NSSAIs from allowed NSSAI, configured NSSAI, or default configured NSSAI.
In roaming scenarios, requested NSSAI can include mapped S-NSSAI(s).
AMF verification process establishes whether requested NSSAI is permitted.
Successful AMF verification results in AMF providing allowed NSSAI to UE.
Registration type conditions guard whether UE includes requested NSSAI during registration procedure.
Registration type conditions guard whether AMF includes allowed NSSAI during registration procedure.
Generic UE configuration update procedure can change allowed NSSAI and associated registration area.
Generic UE configuration update procedure may trigger registration procedure to update allowed NSSAI.
